gelo can now be called by name: **`/gelo`** or **`@gelo`** in Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini and any other LLM.

```
/gelo                   menu: what gelo can do, where is your game now?
/gelo idea <pitch>      /gelo plan      /gelo ui      /gelo code      /gelo anim
/gelo map               /gelo audit     /gelo launch
@gelo <anything>        gelo picks the right skill (and chains them for "make me a game")
```

## What's new
- **`gelo` skill**: the entry point. It shows the menu, routes a task to the right skill by alias or by meaning, and runs the pipeline (idea -> plan -> UI -> code -> animation -> map -> audit -> launch), handing off after each step.
- **ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude.ai / any LLM pack** (`llm/`): Custom GPT instructions under 8,000 characters, one knowledge file per skill and an all-in-one prompt. All of it is generated from the skills, so it stays in sync with them.
- **Installer `--for agents|all`** (`-For` in PowerShell): copies the skills into `.agents/skills/` for Codex (`$gelo`), ChatGPT desktop (`@gelo`), Gemini CLI, Cursor and other Agent Skills tools.
- **MIT license.** Use the skills, scripts and Luau template in your own games, paid ones included.

## Downloads
| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `gelo-chatgpt-pack-v0.10.0.zip` | **ChatGPT Custom GPT** (then `@gelo` in any chat), Gemini Gem, Claude.ai Project. Unzip and follow `START-HERE.md`: paste `1-instructions/gelo-instructions.md` and upload `2-knowledge/`. |
| `gelo-full-v0.10.0.md` | Any LLM with a large context (API, Open WebUI, LM Studio, Ollama, ...): use it as the system prompt. |
| `gelo-skills-v0.10.0.zip` | The skill folders, to unzip into `.claude/skills/` or `.agents/skills/` by hand. |

## Install or update
Claude Code plugin:
```
/plugin install roblox-studio --marketplace G3LO1/gelo
/plugin update roblox-studio
```
Copy the skills into a game folder:
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/G3LO1/gelo/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --for all
```
